rationale: SYK gapped down ~7.6% on earnings miss and is now trading at 78.7% of today's range near the session high, well above VWAP ($292.88) and the 9-EMA ($294.67), suggesting a bounce from the morning low is already largely priced in. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.45%, VIXY +8.49%), which creates headwinds for a long, while the stock's proximity to today's high ($299.17) and negative earnings catalyst limit short conviction given the already-large gap. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear at this mid-range, post-bounce juncture.
